newsitem.title: LATVIA: VENTSPILS NAFTA MARCH, Q1 RELOADINGS RISE.
newsitem.headline: VENTSPILS NAFTA MARCH, Q1 RELOADINGS RISE.

text.p: Reloadings of crude oil and oil products at Latvia's Ventspils terminal in March rose to 2.4 million tonnes, made up of 1.2 million tonnes of crude oil and one million tonnes of diesel, the company said on Wednesday.

The terminal, one of the main outlets for Russian crude in the region, said in a statement that during the first quarter of 1997 some 6.7 million tonnes were reloaded, an increase of 600,000 tonnes on the same period in 1996.
Ventspils Nafta terminal reloaded 25.2 million tonnes of oil and oil products last year, showing a growth of throughput by five million tonnes against 1995, the company added.
